notes: MADToken (src/MADToken.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 built on the vendored OpenZeppelin Contracts v5.0.2 ERC20. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints INITIAL_SUPPLY, 1,000,000,000 MAD at 18 decimals (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units), once to msg.sender, which is the launch factory in ProjectFactory.launchCustom. No further mint path exists: _mint is called only in the constructor, and the contract has no owner, roles, pause, blacklist, freeze, seizure, burnFrom, upgrade, initializer or recovery entry point. Transfers, approvals and transferFrom are plain ERC-20 with no burn, tax, reflection, rebase or vesting, so the factory's transfer of the swarm share to the MerkleDistributor, the single-sided pool seed through the Uniswap v4 PoolManager, the remainder forwarded to economics.remainderTo, distributor claims and trader swaps each move exactly the stated amount. The token makes no external calls, links no libraries and has no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. There are no application contracts in this launch. pool.pairedCurrency is IMD on Ethereum; pool.fee 12500, tickSpacing 60 and initialPrice are the launch policy's values, and the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
